title: Rishyashringa is brought from the woods
introduction: Sumantra, the minister continues his narration to his king Dasharatha, about Rishyashringa's arrival at Anga kingdom of King Romapaada and his marriage with Princess Shantha, the daughter of Romapada.
closing: इति वाल्मीकिरामायणे अदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे दशमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 10th chapter in Bala Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana,the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
सुमंत्रश्चोदितो राज्ञा प्रोवाचेदं वचस्तदा |
यथर्ऋष्यशृङ्गस्त्वानीतो येनोपायेन मंत्रिभिः
तन्मे निगदितं सर्वं शृणु मे मंत्रिभिः सह
verses.iast:
sumantraḥ codito rājñā provāca idam vacaḥ tadā |
yathā ṛṣyaśṛñgaḥ tu ānīto yena upāyena mantribhiḥ
tanme nigaditam sarvam śṛṇu me mantribhiḥ saha
verses.translation: Sumantra thus motivated by King Dasharatha, said these words to king "Oh! King, how and with which idea Sage Rishyasringa is brought by the ministers of Romapada, all that will be spoken... that may please be listened from me along with ministers...

glosses.meaning: as to how, Rishyasringa, is brought
all, listen, from me, with ministers

verses.devanagari:
रोमपादमुवाचेदं सहामात्यः पुरोहितः |
उपायो निरपायोऽयमस्माभिरभिचिन्तितः
verses.iast:
romapādam uvāca idam saha amātyaḥ purohitaḥ |
upāyo nirapāyo ayam asmābhiḥ abhicintitaḥ
verses.translation: "The ministers along with clergyman have spoken this way to King Romapaada, "this is a non-harmful pan well thought over by us...

glosses.meaning: a plan, not harmful, this one

verses.devanagari:
ऋष्यशृङ्गो वनचरस्तपःस्वाध्यायसंयुतः |
अनभिज्ञस्तु नारीणां विषयाणां सुखस्य च
verses.iast:
ṛṣyaśṛñgo vanacaraḥ tapaḥ svādhyāya saṃyutaḥ |
anabhijñaḥ tu nārīṇām viṣayāṇām sukhasya ca
verses.translation: "Rishyasringa is a forest-dweller absorbed in ascesis and self-study of Vedic scriptures, and he is not aware of women, or of worldly-matters or of even worldly-pleasures...

glosses.meaning: in ascesis, in Vedic reading, absorbed
in women, of worldly-matters, of pleasure, also

verses.devanagari:
इन्द्रियार्थैरभिमतैर्नरचित्तप्रमाथिभिः |
पुरमानाययिष्यामः क्षिप्रं चाध्यवसीयताम्
verses.iast:
indriyārthaiḥ abhimataiḥ naracitta pramāthibhi |
puram ānāyayiṣyāmaḥ kṣipram ca adhyavasīyatām
verses.translation: "With much desired sense-pleasing objects that will be disquieting the minds of men, we wish bring him to the city... Let it be decided quickly...

glosses.meaning: with much desired, sense, pleasing objects
to city, we wish to bring

verses.devanagari:
गणिकास्तत्र गच्छन्तु रूपवत्यः स्वलंकृताः |
प्रलोभ्य विविधोपायैरानेष्यन्तीह सत्कृताः
verses.iast:
gaṇikāḥ tatra gacchantu rūpavatyaḥ svalaṅkṛtāḥ |
pralobhya vividha upāyaiḥ āneṣyanti iha satkṛtāḥ
verses.translation: "Beautiful and well decorated courtesans will go there to bring him hither by tempting with many a feint, and let the courtesans be given ample gifts...

glosses.meaning: courtesans, there, they go, amply gifted [by you]

verses.devanagari:
श्रुत्वा तथेति राजा च प्रत्युवाच पुरोहितम् |
पुरोहितो मंत्रिणश्च तथा चक्रुश्च ते तदा
verses.iast:
śrutvā tathā iti rājā ca pratyuvāca purohitam |
purohito mantriṇaḥ ca tathā cakruḥ ca te tathā
verses.translation: "Hearing that the King replied the priest, "Let it be so..." and then the priests and ministers have carried out the plan that way...

verses.devanagari:
वारमुख्यास्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा वनं प्रविविशुर्महत् |
आश्रमस्याविदूरेऽस्मिन्यत्नं कुर्वन्ति दर्शने
ऋषेः पुत्रस्य धीरस्य नित्यमाश्रमवासिनः |
verses.iast:
vāramukhyāḥ tu tat śrutvā vanam praviviśuḥ mahat |
āśramasya avidūre asmin yatnam kurvanti da.rśane
ṛṣeḥ putrasya dhIrasya nityam āśrama vāsinaḥ |
verses.translation: "On hearing that order of the king those best courtesans have entered that great forest, and they camped not very far from that hermitage, making all the trials for showing themselves off to a glance of that sage.
notes: Any dictionary would give the meaning of courtesan as 'whore' or as 'court mistress'. But in Indian context, the courtesan is not to be taken in such a lowly way as just a prostitute or a whore. They belong to a caste/class of artists. Juxtaposed to the Four-Caste system there was a deva dasi Temple Dancers system, which is the artist's class. On their receiving enough education and skills in the performing arts and as per their capabilities, they will be nominated as Court Dancers or Temple Dancers and the like. Ancients recognized sixty-four arts catuṣaṣṭi kalā , which include right from music, dance, and drama, sculpture, painting etc., up to the art of thievery. Kings in their political or sovereign pursuits variedly used these Deva Daasis, the courtesans.

glosses.meaning: courtesans, best of them, that, hearing
of hermitage, not, very, far away
to catch a glance [to show themselves to sage]

verses.devanagari:
पितुः स नित्यसंतुष्टो नातिचक्राम चाश्रमात्
न तेन जन्मप्रभृति दृष्टपूर्वं तपस्विना |
स्त्री वा पुमान्वा यच्चान्यत्सत्त्वं नगरराष्ट्रजम्
verses.iast:
pituḥ sa nitya santuṣṭo na aticakrāma ca āśramāt
na tena janma prabhṛti dṛṣṭa pūrvam tapasvinā |
strī vā pumān vā yacca anyat sattvam nagara rāṣṭrajam
verses.translation: "Always satisfied is sage Rishyasringa to be in hermitage, thus he never stirred out of that hermitage, and thus he has not seen any female, or a male, or even any others objects of pleasure, either of city or of countryside from the time of birth onwards...
notes: Rishyasringa is thus not aware of gender differentiation or exposed to any other object of pleasure, and thus his father conditioned him to achieve some supreme ritual ideal.

glosses.meaning: not, out of way, stirred out

verses.devanagari:
ततः कदाचित्तं देशमाजगाम यदृच्छया |
विभाण्डकसुतस्तत्र ताश्चापश्यद्वरांगनाः
verses.iast:
tataḥ kadācit tam deśam ājagāma yadṛcchayā |
vibhāṇḍaka sutaḥ tatra tāḥ ca apaśyat varāṅganāḥ
verses.translation: "Then at one time Rishyasringa casually arrived at that place, and hasseen those comely females.

glosses.meaning: there, them, comely, females, has seen.

verses.devanagari:
ताश्चित्रवेषाः प्रमदा गायंत्यो मधुरस्वरम् |
ऋषिपुत्रमुपागम्य सर्वा वचनमब्रुवन्
verses.iast:
tāḥ citra veṣāḥ pramadā gāyantyo madhura svaram |
ṛṣi putram upāgaṃya sarvā vacanam abruvan
verses.translation: "They the lustful women are amazingly attired and singing melodious tunes, all of them neared the sage's son and spoke these words...

glosses.meaning: all of them, at Sage's son, nearing

verses.devanagari:
कस्त्वं किं वर्तसे ब्रह्मन् ज्ञातुमिच्छामहे वयम् |
एकस्त्वं विजने घोरे वने चरसि शंस नः
verses.iast:
kaḥ tvam kim vartase brahman jñātum icchāmahe vayam |
ekaḥ tvam vijane dūre vane carasi śaṃsa naḥ
verses.translation: "Who you are? Why you move lonely in these deep and desolate forests, why you conduct yourself like this? Oh! Brahman, we are interested to know... please tell us..."

glosses.meaning: lonely, devoid, of people [desolate,] in deep, forests

verses.devanagari:
अदृष्टरूपास्तास्तेन काम्यरूपा वने स्त्रियः |
हार्दात्तस्य मतिर्जाता ह्याख्यातुं पितरं स्वकम्
verses.iast:
adṛṣṭa rūpāḥ tāḥ tena kāṃya rūpā vane striyaḥ |
hārdāt tasya matiḥ jātā akhyātum pitaram svakam
verses.translation: "Those women are in most desirable form and hitherto he has not seen such forms in that forest, hence a kind of friendship spouted, with which he is inclined to detail about his father...

glosses.meaning: most desirable, in form, those, women are
[thereby a sort of friendship is peeping out,] friendlily
about his, father, to detail, tasya matir jaata = his, mind, born [he is inclined to.]

verses.devanagari:
पिता विभाण्डकोऽस्माकं तस्याहं सुत औरसः |
ऋष्यशृङ्ग इति ख्यातं नामकर्म च मे भुवि
verses.iast:
pitā vibhāṇḍako asmākam tasya aham suta aurasaḥ |
ṛṣyaśṛñga iti khyātam nāma karma ca me bhuvi
verses.translation: "My father is Sage Vibhandaka and I am his true descent son. I am known as Rishyasringa, by my name and by an event on my birth, and thus renowned on earth..."
notes: The birth-event associated with his name is that he is born with a horn on the crown of his head. Thus he is named as Rishyasringa, i.e., ṛṣi= the Sage; sṛñga= horn; a Sage with a horn, and this here he recalls his birth time event.

glosses.meaning: I am, his, true descent, son
[ used here to indicate his birth time even of horn on head

verses.devanagari:
इहाश्रमपदोऽस्माकं समीपे शुभदर्शनाः |
करिष्ये वोऽत्र पूजां वै सर्वेषां विधिपूर्वकम्
verses.iast:
iha āśrama pado'smākam samīpe śubha darśanāḥ |
kariṣye vo'tra pūjām vai sarveṣām vidhi pūrvakam
verses.translation: "Our hermitage is here only, oh, august ones, I wish to perform scripturally worship to you all verily there..." thus said the sage to the courtesans.

glosses.meaning: according to scriptures worship, I wish to perform.

verses.devanagari:
ऋषिपुत्रवचः श्रुत्वा सर्वासां मतिरास वै |
तदाश्रमपदं द्रष्टुं जग्मुः सर्वास्ततोऽङ्गनाः
verses.iast:
ṛṣi putra vacaḥ śrutvā sarvāsām matirāsa vai |
tat āśrama padam draṣṭum jagmuḥ sarvāḥ tato aṅganaḥ
verses.translation: "On hearing the words of sage's son, all those courtesans are verily inclined to see the threshold of that hermitage, then all the women went to hermitage.

verses.devanagari:
गतानां तु ततः पूजां ऋषिपुत्रश्चकार ह |
इदमर्घ्यमिदं पाद्यमिदं मूलं फलं च नः
verses.iast:
gatānām tu tataḥ pūjām ṛṣi putraḥ cakāra ha |
idam arghyam idam pādyam idam mūlam phalam ca naḥ
verses.translation: "On going there, then the Sage's son performed worship saying "Here is our hand-wash, here is our feet-wash, here are our tuber fruits, here are the juicy fruits of ours... "
notes: This portrays the exclusion of the sage's son from the rest of the world by his father. He worshipped the courtesans, as he would worship some super-natural deities by saying the above words, which will usually be used in ritual worship of Hindu deities. He being a fruitarian has offered the courtesans the tuber fruits like sweet potatoes etc., which are ridiculous to urbanites, that too to the pleasure-taking courtesans.

glosses.meaning: worship, sage's son, has performed, verily

verses.devanagari:
प्रतिगृह्य तु तां पूजां सर्वा एव समुत्सुकाः |
ऋषेर्भीताश्च शीघ्रं तु गमनाय मतिं दधुः
verses.iast:
pratigṛhya tu tām pūjām sarvā eva samutsukāḥ |
ṛṣer bhītāḥ ca śīghram tu gamanāya matim dadhuḥ
verses.translation: "All of them have received that kind of worship much enthusiastically, but dread at the arrival of the sage Vibhandaka, they quickly made-up their mind to make away from there.

glosses.itrans: taaH sarvaaH sam utsukaaH taam puujaam pratigR^ihya
glosses.iast: tāḥ sarvāḥ sam utsukāḥ tām pūjām pratigṛhya
glosses.devanagari: ताः सर्वाः सं उत्सुकाः तां पूजां प्रतिगृह्य
glosses.meaning: they, all, enthusiastically, that, worship, having received
quickly, to make away, that way, in mind, made-up.

verses.devanagari:
अस्माकमपि मुख्यानि फलानीमानि वै द्विज |
गृहाण विप्र भद्रं ते भक्षयस्व च मा चिरम्
verses.iast:
asmākam api mukhyāni phalāni imāni he dvija |
gṛhāṇa vipra bhadram te bhakṣayasva ca mā aciram
verses.translation: " 'Take these important fruits of ours, oh, Brahman, you be safe, oh, holy one... eat them before long....' Said courtesans to Rishyasringa.]

glosses.meaning: ours, important, fruits, these are, indeed

verses.devanagari:
ततस्तास्तं समालिंग्य सर्वा हर्षसमन्विताः |
मोदकान्प्रददुस्तस्मै भक्ष्यांश्च विविधान् शुभान्
verses.iast:
tataḥ tāḥ tam samāliṅgya sarvā harṣa samanvitāḥ |
modakān pradaduḥ tasmai bhakṣyām ca vividhān śubhān
verses.translation: "Then all of the courtesans have embraced him and all of them with a kind of mirthfulness in the offing, presented sweet-balls and other varieties of best sweetmeats to him.

glosses.itrans: tataH taaH sarvaa tam sam aaliN^gya
glosses.iast: tataḥ tāḥ sarvā tam sam āliṇ^gya
glosses.devanagari: ततः ताः सर्वा तं सं आलिण्^ग्य
glosses.meaning: then, they, all, him, on embracing

verses.devanagari:
तानि चास्वाद्य तेजस्वी फलानीति स्म मन्यते |
अनास्वादितपूर्वाणि वने नित्यनिवासिनाम्
verses.iast:
tāni ca āsvādya tejasvī phalāni iti sma manyate |
anāsvādita pūrvāṇi vane nitya nivāsinām
verses.translation: "Having relished the sweets, that resplendent sage supposed them to be fruits only, for he did not taste sweets earlier, as he is always forest-bound.

glosses.meaning: self-luminous one, in forests, always, dwelling [therefore]
resplendent one, fruits, only, supposed them.

verses.devanagari:
आपृच्छ्य च तदा विप्रं व्रतचर्यां निवेद्य च |
गच्छन्ति स्मापदेशात्ताः भीतास्तस्य पितुः स्त्रियः
verses.iast:
āpṛcchya ca tadā vipram vrata caryām nivedya ca |
gacchanti sma apadeśāt tā bhītāḥ tasya pituḥ striyaḥ
verses.translation: "Taking leave of the Sage Rishyasringa on pretence that they also have to perform devotional duties, they the courtesans departed from there on the pretext of their daily worship, while they actually feared for the arrival of Rishyasringa's father who may hurl curses on his arrival...]

verses.devanagari:
गतासु तासु सर्वासु काश्यपस्यात्मजो द्विजः |
अस्वस्थहृदयश्चासीद् दुःखाच्च परिवर्तते
verses.iast:
gatāsu tāsu sarvāsu kāśyapasya ātmajo dvijaḥ |
asvastha hṛdayaḥ ca āsīt duḥkhāt ca parivartate
verses.translation: "After the departure of all them the courtesans, that Brahman Rishyasringa, the grandson of Sage Kaashyapa, is disturbed at heart and even behaved sadly...

glosses.meaning: their, all, going away, while becoming true
in sadness, even, he behaved, he is.

verses.devanagari:
ततोऽपरेद्युस्तं देशमाजगाम स वीर्यवान् |
विभाण्डकसुतः श्रीमान्मनसा चिन्तयन्मुहुः
मनोज्ञा यत्र ता दृष्टा वारमुख्याः स्वलंकृताः |
verses.iast:
tato'pare dyuḥ tam deśam ājagāma sa vīryavān |
vibhāṇḍaka sutaḥ śrīmān manasā vicintayan muhuḥ
manojñā yatra tā dṛṣṭā vāramukhyāḥ svalaṅkṛtāḥ |
verses.translation: "Then on the next day Rishyasringa, son of Vibhandaka and the prosperous sage with ascetic power has arrived at that place where he saw well-decorated and delightful courtesans recollecting in mind repetitively about them alone.

glosses.meaning: in mind, recollecting, repetitively manoj~naa = delightful ones [women]

verses.devanagari:
दृष्टैव च ततो विप्रमायान्तं हृष्टमानसाः
उपसृत्य ततः सर्वास्तास्तमूचुरिदं वचः |
एह्याश्रमपदं सौम्य ह्यस्माकमिति चाब्रुवन्
verses.iast:
dṛṣṭvā eva ca tato vipram āyāntam hṛṣṭa mānasāḥ
upasṛtya tataḥ sarvāḥ tāḥ tam ūcur idam vacaḥ |
ehi āśrama padam sauṃya asmākam iti ca abruvan
verses.translation: " Then on seeing the arrival of that Brahman, the courtesans felt happy at heart, and all of those courtesans on surrounding him said, "oh, gentle one, welcome to the threshold of our hermitage...

glosses.meaning: then, that Brahman, on seeing, thus, to have come
they, all, then, on surrounding him

verses.devanagari:
चित्राण्यत्र बहूनि स्युर्मूलानि च फलनि च |
तत्राप्येष विशेषेण विधिर्हि भविता ध्रुवम्
verses.iast:
citrāṇi atra bahūni syuḥ mūlāni ca phalani ca |
tatra api eṣa viśeṣeṇa vidhiḥ hi bhavitā dhruvam
verses.translation: "There are excellent tuber fruits and fruits and there will be a very distinctive hospitality... definitely indeed..." So said the courtesans.

glosses.itrans: atra chitraaNi bahuuni muulaani ca phalani syuH
glosses.iast: atra citrāṇi bahūni mūlāni ca phalani syuḥ
glosses.devanagari: अत्र चित्राणि बहूनि मूलानि च फलनि स्युः
glosses.meaning: there, excellent, tubers, fruits, also, are there

verses.devanagari:
श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तासां सर्वासां हृदयङ्गमम् |
गमनाय मतिं चक्रे तं च निन्युस्तदा स्त्रियः
verses.iast:
śrutvā tu vacanam tāsām sarvāsām hṛdayam gamam |
gamanāya matim cakre tam ca ninyuḥ tathā striyaḥ
verses.translation: "On hearing the heart-pleasing words of all those courtesans, Rishyasringa made up his mind to go over there, and then those women took him away [to their place in Anga Kingdom.]

glosses.meaning: to go there, his mind, made up
then, those women him, took away.

verses.devanagari:
तत्र चानीयमाने तु विप्रे तस्मिन्महात्मनि |
ववर्ष सहसा देवो जगत्प्रह्लादयंस्तदा
verses.iast:
tatra ca ānīyamāne tu vipre tasmin mahātmani |
vavarṣa sahasā devo jagat prahlādayan tadā
verses.translation: "While that great soul ad Brahman Rishyasringa while being brought into Anga Kingdom, then the Rain-god quickly showered rain in Anga kingdom to the delight of the world.

glosses.meaning: quickly, in there in Anga kingdom, showered rain.

verses.devanagari:
वर्षेणैवागतं विप्रं विषयं स्वं नराधिपः |
प्रत्युद्गम्य मुनिं प्रह्वः शिरसा च महीं गतः
अर्घ्यं च प्रददौ तस्मै न्यायतः सुसमाहितः |
वव्रे प्रसादं विप्रेन्द्रान्मा विप्रं मन्युराविशेत्
verses.iast:
varṣeṇa eva āgatam vipram tāpasam sa narādhipaḥ |
prati udgaṃya munim prahvaḥ śirasā ca mahīm gataḥ
arghyam ca pradadau tasmai nyāyataḥ susamāhitaḥ |
vavre prasādam vipreindrāt mā vipram manyuḥ āviśet
verses.translation: "The king Romapada personally proceeded towards that Brahman Rishyasring who is now entering Anga kingdom along with rains, made prostratiion before him, offered water customarily with dedication, and then the king Romapada besought beneficence of the best sage Rishyasringa to save him and his kingdom from the fury of his father Sage Vibhandaka, if sage Vibhandaka were to know about this pursuit of bringing Rishyasringa to Anga country, at a later time ...
notes: The salutation in prostration on the ground is usually performed before Gods or Deities, in reverence. It is called sāṣṭānga praṇāmam = sa aṣṭa anga praṇāmam , i.e., saluting with eight body parts touching the ground, indicating his absolute surrender to the worshipped.

glosses.meaning: let that Brahman be possessed by anger.

verses.devanagari:
अन्तःपुरं प्रविश्यास्मै कन्यां दत्त्वा यथाविधि |
शांतां शान्तेन मनसा राजा हर्षमवाप सः
verses.iast:
antaḥpuram praveśya asmai kanyām dattvā yathāvidhi |
śāntām śāntena manasā rājā harṣam avāpa saḥ
verses.translation: "On entering the palace princess Shanta is given to Rishyasringa in customary marriage, and then that King Romapada obtained rejoice with a peaceful mind.

glosses.itrans: kanyaam shantaam asmai yathaa vidhi datvaa
glosses.iast: kanyām śantām asmai yathā vidhi datvā
glosses.devanagari: कन्यां शन्तां अस्मै यथा विधि दत्वा
glosses.meaning: bride, Shanta, to him, customarily, on giving
with peaceful, heart, rejoice, he obtained.

verses.devanagari:
एवं स न्यवसत्तत्र सर्वकामैः सुपूजितः |
ऋष्यशृङ्गो महातेजाः शन्तया सह भार्यया
verses.iast:
evam sa nyavasat tatra sarva kāmaiḥ supūjitaḥ |
ṛṣyaśR^ñgo mahātejā śantāyā saha bhāryayā
verses.translation: " Thus that great fulgent Rishyasringa lived in Anga kingdom along with his wife Shanta, and with all his desires fulfilled and also well worshipped" [Thus Sumantra said the legend of Rishyasringa to King Dasharatha.]
